script: Kitchen note. The supply line under the sink failed overnight. I pulled the toe kick and the subfloor is reading twenty eight percent near the dishwasher.
Hall bath. Drywall is wicking about fourteen inches behind the vanity. We will flood cut at two feet on that wall.
Basement is category two from the sump pump. Carpet and pad are out. Concrete reads dry except a strip about six feet wide by the stairs.
Second bedroom closet has visible growth on the back wall. Setting up containment with a HEPA air scrubber before we open it.
Day two readings. The hallway baseboard dropped from thirty five to nineteen. Dehumidifier is pulling well.
Laundry room. Washing machine hose split. About sixty square feet of vinyl plank is lifting. Subfloor is particleboard and swollen at the seams.
Crawl space has standing water about three inches deep under the family room. Vapor barrier is torn in two places.
Living room ceiling is stained under the upstairs bathroom. Moisture meter shows it is dry now, so this is an old stain.
Primary closet. Hardwood is cupping along the exterior wall. Readings are around twenty two percent on the planks.
Office note. Category one from a cracked fitting in the wall. Insulation is wet for about eight feet. Drywall comes out to four feet.
Guest bath toilet overflow, so category three. Baseboard and the bottom two feet of drywall go. Tile floor can stay.
Entry. Tile is fine but the grout lines read wet. I left one air mover pointed at the threshold for now.
Den carpet pad is soaked about four feet out from the wall. Carpet can be floated and dried in place.
Dining room. The water came under the wall from the kitchen. About ninety square feet of hardwood is affected.
Utility room water heater failed. Class two loss. LGR dehumidifier and two air movers set this afternoon.
Family room. Readings on the baseboard are all under fifteen now. I think we can pull equipment tomorrow.
Kitchen cabinets. The toe kicks are swollen and the cabinet backs read wet. We will need to drill weep holes.
Second bedroom. Vinyl plank over concrete. Water is trapped under about forty square feet near the closet.
Hallway day three. Drywall reads twelve percent, back to dry standard. Removing the air movers today.
Basement stairs. The bottom three treads are soaked and the stringer reads thirty percent. Containment is not needed here.
